data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017 the Syndicate released $267k of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (period ended December 2016: nil), arising predominantly from the Energy, Political risk and Property Divisions. These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2017.

prior_year_events.event_name: Release of technical reserves for prior periods
prior_year_events.impact_description: Released $267k of technical reserves in respect of prior periods, arising predominantly from the Energy, Political risk and Property Divisions due to favourable claims development on prior year losses.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a small prior-year release of technical reserves of $267k in 2017 (period ended December 2016: nil). The release arose predominantly in the Energy, Political risk and Property divisions and was driven by favourable claims development on prior year losses.

data.data_quality_notes: All figures are taken from the syndicate financial statements presented in United States Dollars and shown in $'000. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (prior year comparative column). Prior year development is explicitly stated in the Movement in prior year's provision note as a $267k release; this is taken as a gross figure. No per-LOB amounts for the release are provided. The claims development triangle exists but only contains 2016 and 2017 underwriting years, so it cannot be used to compute prior-year development.
